fusions.name: Charged Fletching
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arcane arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 arcane damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbound String
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of arcane force from the string that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Raw Surge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell Nock
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 5 seconds.
